I have them now at 12-19 after today’s game.

From: Alter, Marlowe 
Sent: Thursday, April 30, 2020 2:24 PM
To: Fenech, Anthony <afenech@freepress.com>; Crawford, Kirkland <kcrawford@freepress.com>
Subject: What is the Virtual Tigers record?
Game story says they started the day 11-18, so now 11-19, but then it also says they played Game 31 today. The game setup for tomorrow says 12-19.
Detroit Free Press sports web editor
